why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Connect your X account Open the Mirra AI contribute page . The site tells you to connect your X account.
2 Step 2 : Find valuable content on X Identify high-value content on X. You can also post your own insights on X as a creator, so that a scout can submit them.
3 Step 3 : Tag @MirraTerminal in the replies Under the post you picked, reply and tag @MirraTerminal. This submits the content to Mirra for AI training.
4 Step 4 : Wait for validation Validators review the submission. If it passes, the scout and the creator both earn NLP.
5 Step 5 : Check your NLP on the leaderboard Follow your validated scouts, creations and NLP on the Mirra leaderboard .
